name: Aino Ema
source:
I was a hero in a different world.
Level 86. Strong among humans.
A calm and composed girl. A cool and impressive hero.

...Or so you might think, but the perverted hero finds the Demon Lord's appearance as a girl so appealing that she tries to engage in excessive physical contact with her.

[Translated from the [url=https://kumanomi-soft.amusecraft.com/tenmao/#Character]official website[/url]]
